clips.hook: He claimed to be the angel. He was lying the whole time.
clips.reason: Moxie Marlinspike drops the biggest bluff of the game — claims angel, clears Ryan, survives trial.
clips.summary: Signal founder Moxie reveals he saved Ryan as the angel during a heated trial against Palmer Luckey.

clips.hook: The mafia wins. And it's the guy everyone trusted.
clips.reason: Final vote ends the game — Moxie was mafia all along and gets thrown into piranhas as a victory lap.
clips.summary: The final vote kills Moxie, but the mafia still wins — the ultimate twist ending with tech legends stunned.

clips.hook: Sam Altman just learned Moxie lied to his face for 30 minutes.
clips.reason: Post-game reactions — players realize they were masterfully deceived by a first-time mafia player.
clips.summary: After the reveal, Sam Altman and the table react in disbelief that Moxie fooled everyone despite claiming angel early.

clips.hook: They voted her out unanimously. Then the electric chair.
clips.reason: Josie Zayner gets unanimously voted out and narrated into an electric chair execution — dark comedy gold.
clips.summary: The town votes unanimously to kill Josie, who gets a dramatic electric chair death narration.

clips.hook: Palmer Luckey got stoned to death over a Shirley Jackson reference.
clips.reason: Palmer is killed by stoning in the tradition of The Lottery — generational culture clash over a classic short story.
clips.summary: Palmer Luckey is executed by stoning, sparking a hilarious debate about whether everyone read Shirley Jackson's The Lottery.

clips.hook: Final trial. He still claims he's the angel.
clips.reason: Climactic Moxy vs Trey trial — Moxie delivers an elaborate angel defense while the table debates his survival.
clips.summary: With the game on the line, Moxie and Trey face trial as Moxie argues why surviving three rounds proves he's the angel.

clips.hook: They found his body in five shipping containers.
clips.reason: Ryan Petersen's murder announcement is brutally creative — pieces found across five shipping containers.
clips.summary: Flexport founder Ryan Petersen is killed off with one of the most absurd death narrations of the night.

clips.hook: Sam Altman walked in and said he's going unhinged tonight.
clips.reason: Celebrity-packed cold open — Sam Altman, pro poker players, and deal negotiators trash-talk before the game.
clips.summary: The intro sets the tone with tech legends boasting about lying, winning, and going unhinged for Mafia night.

clips.hook: The Second Amendment could have solved this mafia problem.
clips.reason: Rules explanation derails into a guns joke — instant meme potential with Founders Fund energy.
clips.summary: During the rules rundown, a player jokes that townspeople having guns would eliminate the mafia problem entirely.

clips.hook: How is Moxie still alive and never on trial?
clips.reason: Late-game paranoia peaks as players question why Moxie keeps surviving despite claiming angel.
clips.summary: With Brian Johnson dead, the remaining players finally question why Moxie has never been nominated despite dominating the game.
